evidence.claim: Query family '<company> engineering challenges nearshoring' accounts for most of the nearshoring-benefits post's impressions: siteimprove 8,092, causalens 8,088, rallyware 6,543, sydecar 5,873, all 0 clicks, pos 4-8
evidence.value: >30,000 imp of the page's 47,822 (joined) are this pattern

evidence.claim: Query family 'number of employees at <random domain>' drives /about-us striking-distance impressions: cloudsports.at 3,237, cloudcomunicaciones.cl 2,903, plus dozens more, all 0 clicks
evidence.value: 10,394 imp pos 8-30 on /about-us are this pattern

evidence.claim: Site non-brand CTR at pos 4-6 is 0.05 percent (35 clicks / 74,528 imp), which is 100x below any plausible organic curve, proving the impression base is not human searches
/compare/toptal-vs-upwork 44,019 imp but top real queries are 'toptal vouchers' (1,361) and 'toptal api public' (588), navigational-for-toptal, not buyer intent for us

impact.estimate: Not a fix, a measurement rule: any prioritisation ranked on raw impressions_90d over-weights these pages by 3-10x. The likely source is AI agents issuing templated searches (pattern matches LLM tool-use queries). CTR-based impact estimates must use industry curves, not our own

recommendation: Synthesis session: filter query families matching '<X> engineering challenges nearshoring' and 'number of employees at <domain>' (and similar templated shapes) before ranking anything on impressions. Do not treat the nearshoring-benefits post or /about-us as top opportunities on raw impressions. Positive spin worth noting: AI agents are repeatedly landing on our pages as a source, which corroborates the AEO strategy.
